name: Top Block
description: A solid tone header with a small capitals eyebrow and a large serif headline, and a framed photo inset below with a margin all round.
bestFor: first slide of a gallery carousel
a photo that shouldn't have words on it
photoTip: The photo is shown in full inside a frame, so any photo works; portrait photos fill the frame best.
